component.name: Panda
component.summary: Local AI assistant on your NPU

description.p: Panda chats with a model running on your AMD Ryzen AI NPU through FastFlowLM. Nothing leaves your computer.

It can search the web, open apps, files and websites, change settings such as dark mode, power mode, Night Light, volume, brightness, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, and read battery and system information. Changes that could disconnect you, and general desktop settings, ask first.
Type a question in the GNOME overview search and pick “Ask:” to send it to Panda.

ul.li: Searches the web (DuckDuckGo, with Wikipedia as a fallback) and reads web pages
Knows this computer: model, CPU, memory, NPU, OS
Changes more settings: power mode, Night Light, and any GNOME desktop setting (asks first)
Opens the right page of GNOME Settings
Hard requests can be handed to a bigger local model (Preferences → Smarter Model)
Fixed: FastFlowLM 1.0.9 was never detected as started
Startup errors show the end of FastFlowLM's log
The model loads when you start typing and unloads after 5 minutes idle
Unload Model in the main menu frees memory right away
Context length defaults to 8K tokens instead of the model's maximum
Preferences for context length and the idle timer
